parameters.help_en: The name of the execution plan
parameters.name: action_plan_name

parameters.help_en: The script to run the job. The script must be Base64-encoded
parameters.name: script

parameters.help_en: The pre-execution script. The script must be Base64-encoded
parameters.name: prolog_script

parameters.help_en:
The type of resource for the execution target. The value can be the vCPU capacity or the number of executor nodes. Valid values:

- VCpuCapacity: vCPU capacity

- ExecutorCapacity: number of executor nodes
parameters.help_zh:
执行目标资源类型：vCPU容量或者执行节点数。取值范围如下：

- VCpuCapacity：vCPU容量

- ExecutorCapacity：执行节点数
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The desired size of the resource for the execution plan. For example, if you set ResourceType to VcpuCapacity, this parameter specifies the number of vCPUs that you want to maintain for the execution plan
parameters.help_zh: 执行计划期望的资源规模。如果ResourceType是VcpuCapacity的话，该字段表示执行计划希望保有10000vCPU
parameters.name: desired_capacity

element_fields.name: cores

element_fields.help_en: The memory size of the runtime environment. Unit: GiB
element_fields.help_zh: 运行环境的内存大小。单位是GiB
element_fields.name: memory

parameters.help_en: A list of resource configurations for the runtime environment of the execution plan. You can specify 1 to 10 resource configurations
parameters.help_zh: 执行计划运行环境的资源配置列表。资源配置支持 1 ～ 10个
parameters.name: resources

element_fields.help_en: A list of vSwitches that are available for the execution plan in the region. You can specify 0 to 5 vSwitches

element_fields.name: vswitchids

element_fields.help_en: A list of security groups that are available for the execution plan in the region. You can specify 0 to 5 security groups
element_fields.help_zh: 执行计划在该地域可用的安全组列表。安全组支持0～5个
element_fields.name: security_group_id

element_fields.help_en: A list of security group IDs. You can call the [DescribeSecurityGroups](https://api.aliyun.com/document/Ecs/2014-05-26/DescribeSecurityGroups) operation to query information about available security groups
element_fields.help_zh: 交换机ID列表，您可以通过[DescribeSecurityGroups接口](https://api.aliyun.com/document/Ecs/2014-05-26/DescribeSecurityGroups)查询可用交换机信息
element_fields.name: security_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.

- Standard: Standard.

- Dedicated: Dedicated. This type is available only to users in the whitelist.

- Economic: Economy. This type is available only to users in the whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。
- Standard：标准型。
- Dedicated：专属型，需开通白名单使用。
- Economic：经济型，需开通白名单使用
parameters.name: allocation_spec

parameters.help_en:
The computing power level. This parameter is valid only when you set AllocationSpec to Economic. The following types are supported:

- General: General-purpose.

- Performance: Compute-optimized.

Default value: General
parameters.help_zh:
算力等级，仅在资源类型为经济型时有效。支持以下类型：
- General：通用型。
- Performance：性能型。

默认值：General
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_zh: 执行计划的定时周期。单位分钟，取值范围：10 ～ 10080，默认值60
